scope: Evaluator recall fix for strong institutional research-management roles only. A research-project-management vacancy with an otherwise unclear scientific topic is promoted only when multiple independent research-administration signals co-occur, such as research-institute context, project/process coordination, competitive calls or grants, institutional accreditation, governance/reporting, or scientific coordination. Generic project-management roles at research employers remain non-promoted. V1.38 mandatory qualification guards, thresholds, weights, collectors, Spain-only geography, Madrid fallback, Sant Pau bounded transport, seen-state semantics, reporting and Telegram are unchanged.
